changelog:
Initial release of apple-app-store-api.

- Search the Apple App Store by keyword, app name, or publisher.
- Retrieve a full app listing using App Store id or bundle id.
- Fetch user reviews for any app (rating, text, author, and version), paginated by storefront and page.
- All endpoints return structured JSON; 1 credit per call with country-specific data.
- Supports App Store Optimization, competitor research, and bulk metadata exports.
display_name: Apple App Store API - App Search, Listing Detail, Reviews
summary: Search the Apple App Store, read a full app listing by App Store id or bundle id, and pull user reviews as structured JSON. 3 endpoints, 1 credit each, any Apple storefront.
